_comment: Roadmap 2 S6: riding buses, the MRT and the railway with other passengers (src/features/buses, metro, railway; shared code src/entities/transit/). Fares are in data/economy.json → fares (the Products tab of the Google Sheet can override them, kind 'fare'). Distances in metres, times in seconds. Line routes and stations: data/landmarks.json (viaducts = MRT, railways = trains); bus stops are made by the road network (data/traffic.json → busStops).

camera._comment: view = the view a ride starts with ('inside' = from the back of the cabin, 'outside' = behind the vehicle). Change it with the 🎥 button or C. eyeHeight = camera above the cabin floor; eyeBack = metres in front of the back wall; lookYaw / lookPitch = how far you can drag the inside view (radians). outsideScale = chase distance for trains (× the driving camera).

ride._comment: fadeSeconds = the black fade when getting on/off a train or skipping. skipBefore = after ⏩ the vehicle is put this far before its next stop. holdSeconds = how long a train waits for Shoumik at a station while he stands on its platform.

passengers._comment: Other people riding (all adults, everyday Dhaka clothes). count = people per bus / train car on each quality (seated first, then standing); units = how many vehicles/cars near Shoumik get passengers at once (the one he rides always does) — only while he rides or waits at that stop / station. nearDistance = only vehicles closer than this get passengers. standShare = share that stand in the aisle. offPerStop / onPerStop = [min, max] people getting off / on at each stop. walkSpeed = walking to and from the door; walkOut = metres they walk away after getting off. archetypes = who rides (names from data/pedestrians.json, weights).

cabins._comment: Insides of the vehicles (seen from the inside view). Local metres: length along the vehicle, width across, floor = cabin floor above the ground, height = floor to ceiling, window = [from, to] above the floor (open band you look through). seats: rows = 2+2 forward-facing seats with an aisle (pitch = row spacing, back/front = free metres at the back / front), benches = long benches along both walls facing the middle (gaps = [from, to] door spaces along the car). standing = [across, along] spots in the aisle. doors = [side, along] (side +1 = left wall, -1 = right; along = metres from the middle, + = front). driver = [across, along] of the driver's seat (bus). Colours as hex.

bus._comment: stopRadius = stand this close to a bus-stop shelter and a bus is called. noticeSeconds = how long you stand there first (no bus comes while you are wanted or for quietAfterShot seconds after a shot). approach = metres back along the road where the bus starts (it drives up to the stop). speedFactor = bus speed × its normal cruise. doorRange = how close to the door to board. waitAtStop = seconds the bus waits for you once it stands at your stop. lineJunctions = [min, max] junctions to the end of a bus line when you have not picked a stop (it then picks a new one). policeStars = from this many wanted stars the police stop the bus after policeStopSeconds (you are pushed out). type = vehicle type from data/vehicles.json.

metro._comment: entryRadius = stand this close to the stairs under a station. icon / mapColor for the map.

train._comment: Railway (data/landmarks.json → railways). boardRange = how close to the train (on the platform) to get on.
